title: Synthesis, spectroscopic properties, structural characterization, and computational studies of a new non-centrosymmetric hybrid compound: bis-cyanato-N chromium(III) meso-arylporphyrin complex
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,33410-33426
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04378F, Paper
Open Access

Mondher Dhifet, Nabil Benzerroug, Tahani M. Almutairi, Khadra B. Alomari, Nikolay Tumanov, Noureddine Issaoui
In this work, we report the synthesis, spectroscopic properties, electronic behavior, and DFT modeling of a hexa-coordinated chromium(III) porphyrin complex, denoted as [Na(2,2,2crypt)][CrIII(TPP)(NCO)2]·0.406CHCl3 (I).
